module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Direct Pass-Through Price Execution (Independent Fills)
precondition: Group configured for Direct STP routing where each sub-account executes independently.
expected: Child tickets receive individual execution prices; variance logged transparently on each account statement.
coverage_note: Requires LP partial-fill, depth, rejection, or routing fault injection; these dedicated accounts are B-book and no LP simulator was supplied.
